title: Change every element
description:
Write `void doubleAll(std::vector<int>& values)` that doubles every element **in place**.

In a range-based loop, `for (int x : values)` gives you copies. To change the real elements, the loop variable must be a reference.
hints: Write the loop variable as a reference, `for (int& x : values)`. Then `x *= 2;` changes the element inside the vector, not a copy.
unitTests:
TEST("doubles in place") { std::vector<int> v{ 1, 2, 3 }; doubleAll(v); CHECK_EQ(v, (std::vector<int>{ 2, 4, 6 })); }
TEST("negatives and zero") { std::vector<int> v{ -4, 0 }; doubleAll(v); CHECK_EQ(v, (std::vector<int>{ -8, 0 })); }
